t: You're at the church of St Michael and St George, the parish church of the White City estate in west London. The estate is public housing, begun in the 1930s and finished after the Second World War, and the parish also takes in newer developments near the former BBC Television Centre. The church was designed by John Seely, Lord Mottistone, whose practice, Seely and Paget, did the Art Deco interior of Eltham Palace and restored bomb-damaged buildings after the war, including the London Charterhouse and St John Clerkenwell.
